raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner mistakenly directed the WebSurfer to a Wikisource page titled “Father, Son and Holy Ghost” assuming it was Audre Lorde’s poem, but it is actually a hymn by Charles Wesley. This misattribution led the team to an irrelevant source and impeded progress toward finding the poem’s formatted text needed to identify the indented stanza.
